episodeTitle.en: How to ask the right questions, project confidence, and win over skeptics | Paige Costello (Asana)
episodeTitle.zh: 如何提出正确的问题、展现自信并赢得怀疑者 | 佩奇·科斯特洛（Asana）

guestBioOfficial.en: Paige Costello is a beloved product leader with a reputation as a remarkable coach and mentor. She is currently the Head of Core Product at Asana, where she leads the group responsible for Asana’s web, desktop, and mobile apps. Prior to that role, she served as the Director of Product at Intercom and, before that, as a Group PM at Intuit, where she kickstarted her product career through their renowned APM program. In today’s episode, we discuss: • The unique product development process at Asana and how it’s evolved
guestBioOfficial.zh: 佩奇·科斯特洛是一位备受尊敬的产品领导者，素有杰出教练和导师之称。她目前是Asana的核心产品主管，负责领导团队开发Asana的网页、桌面和移动应用。在此之前，她曾在Intercom担任产品总监，并在Intuit担任集团产品经理，通过其著名的APM项目开启了她的产品生涯。在今天的节目中，我们探讨了：• Asana独特的产品开发流程及其演变

title.en: How to ask the right questions, project confidence, and win over skeptics | Paige Costello (Asana)
title.zh: 如何提出正确的问题、展现自信并赢得怀疑者 | 佩奇·科斯特洛（Asana）

summary.en: Paige discusses how Asana evolved its product development process, shifting from yearly planning toward a six-month horizon with frequent revisiting and outcome-aligned teams. She explains how the organization is structured into pillars and areas, each with a specific target customer and problem space, and why over-specifying roadmaps leads teams to make strange scope trade-offs. The episode is full of practical lessons on scaling product planning without losing agility.
summary.zh: Paige 探讨了 Asana 产品开发的演进过程：从年度规划转向以六个月为周期、频繁复盘、并与成果对齐的团队模式。她解释了组织如何划分为“支柱（pillar）”与“领域（area）”，每一块都有特定的目标客户与问题空间，并说明过度细化路线图反而会让团队做出奇怪的范围取舍。本期充满了在不丧失敏捷性的前提下扩展产品规划的实战经验。
